title: Referrals and Authorizations Training Note: Emergency Visit Frequency and Extension Days
content:
Questions answered for representatives on **Referrals and Authorizations**: how emergency frequency bears on an extension of an approved authorization.

**What lengthens the extension on this ground?** Emergency frequency. Where three or more emergency department visits of the patient are dated in the last month, two days are added to the extension; where exactly two are, one day is added; otherwise none.

**Which visits are counted?** The emergency department visits of the patient on the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines dated in the last month.

**Does a single emergency visit in the last month add a day?** No; one visit, or none, adds nothing on this ground.

**Does a fourth visit add more than a third?** No; three or more visits add two days.

| Emergency department visits dated in the last month | Days added to the extension |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2 |
| exactly 2 | 1 |
| 1 or none | 0 |
